name: Crash Zoom
blurb: A violent zoom into the eyes.

shots.action: The subject holds still for a beat, then their expression sharpens as the frame rushes in on them.
shots.sound: A fast rising whoosh slams into a deep cinematic boom.
shots.cameraText: The camera crash-zooms violently toward the face with heavy motion blur and stops hard
shots.framing: an extreme close-up of the eyes
